How do I unlock membership automatically after a successful payment?

A mechanism where the other party proactively notifies an address you configured when something happens·After an event such as a payment, a platform can attempt to deliver an HTTP request to your configured endpoint. Payment platform · eventevt_1042

Orderorder_71 · paid
Endpointhttps://shop.example.com/webhooks/payments

A successful payment creates an event. The platform then attempts delivery to the configured endpoint; this timing does not guarantee immediate arrival.

What a webhook goes through

Notified when it happens: The platform may attempt delivery after an event; timing can vary, and retries or duplicate events are possible.

Your service processes on receipt: On receipt, verify the source and content, then update the order or access state according to the business flow. Acknowledge receipt as the provider expects and read back the business record to verify.

Guard against duplicates and forgery: Notifications may be delayed, fail, be retried, duplicate, or arrive out of order; provider retries still do not guarantee delivery. Verify signatures, deduplicate, and reconcile critical records.

What it does not guarantee

A webhook does not guarantee delivery: network trouble or temporary downtime can make an attempt fail. Follow the provider's retry policy and reconcile critical business records; do not assume every event will arrive.

“

Integrate a webhook for successful payments: configure the receiving address, verify the signature and order number on notification, then unlock membership. Duplicate notifications for the same order must not unlock twice; acknowledge receipt according to the provider's requirements and verify the final order state.
